notes: Three words, but they name the genre and the shape outright: obby is Obby & Platformer with its genre-wide P6, and tower is course-tower, whose wrapping platforms sit above each other and carry the P2. That makes the Tower Obby preset the whole answer, and I took it unchanged rather than padding a thin prompt with obstacles it never mentioned. Silly is dressing, so it changes colour and prop choice and nothing spatial; the author's answers confirm bright candy colours with no specific gag props, and a short quick climb rather than a Tower-of-Hell length ascent. The preset's winner-zone gives the climb somewhere to end, which validation needs, and I left checkpoints out because a course this short is one of the cases where obbies genuinely omit them.
